legend: Iahub isn't well prepared on geometry problems, but he heard that this year there will be a lot of geometry problems on the IOI selection camp. Scared, Iahub locked himself in the basement and started thinking of new problems of this kind. One of them is the following.

Iahub wants to draw n distinct points and m segments on the OX axis. He can draw each point with either red or blue. The drawing is good if and only if the following requirement is met: for each segment [li, ri] consider all the red points belong to it (ri points), and all the blue points belong to it (bi points); each segment i should satisfy the inequality |ri - bi| ≤ 1.
Iahub thinks that point x belongs to segment [l, r], if inequality l ≤ x ≤ r holds.
Iahub gives to you all coordinates of points and segments. Please, help him to find any good drawing.
input: The first line of input contains two integers: n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 100). The next line contains n space-separated integers x1, x2, ..., xn (0 ≤ xi ≤ 100) — the coordinates of the points. The following m lines contain the descriptions of the m segments. Each line contains two integers li and ri (0 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 100) — the borders of the i-th segment.
It's guaranteed that all the points are distinct.
output: If there is no good drawing for a given test, output a single integer -1. Otherwise output n integers, each integer must be 0 or 1. The i-th number denotes the color of the i-th point (0 is red, and 1 is blue).
If there are multiple good drawings you can output any of them.

input.ai: 输入第一行包含两个整数：n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100）和 m（1 ≤ m ≤ 100）。下一行包含 n 个空格分隔的整数 x1, x2, ..., xn（0 ≤ xi ≤ 100）——这些点的坐标。接下来的 m 行包含 m 条线段的描述。每行包含两个整数 li 和 ri（0 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 100）——第 i 条线段的边界。

output.ai: 如果某个测试数据不存在合法的画法，则输出单个整数 -1。否则输出 n 个整数，每个整数必须是 0 或 1。第 i 个数表示第 i 个点的颜色（0 表示红色，1 表示蓝色）。
如果存在多种合法的画法，你可以输出其中任意一种。

legend.ai: Iahub 不擅长几何题，但他听说今年 IOI 选拔集训营会有很多几何题。Iahub 很害怕，于是把自己锁在地下室里，开始思考这类新题目。其中一道题如下。
Iahub 想在 OX 轴上画 n 个互不相同的点和 m 条线段。每个点可以涂成红色或蓝色。当且仅当满足以下条件时，这幅图才是好的：对于每条线段 [l_i, r_i]，设其中红点的数量为 r_i，蓝点的数量为 b_i；每条线段 i 都必须满足不等式 |r_i - b_i| ≤ 1。
如果不等式 l ≤ x ≤ r 成立，Iahub 就认为点 x 属于线段 [l, r]。
Iahub 给出了所有点和线段的坐标。请帮他找到任意一种好的画法。
